paite: Huan Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng huai kha khatna in Zin gamdai alut ua; mipite'n Kadesh ah giahphual asat ua; huai ah Miriam asi a, huai ah avui uhi.
heading: Kadesh A Thil Tungte
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

paite: Omkhawmte a ding in tui a-om kei a; Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm uh.
english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

paite: Mite'n, "TOUPA ma a i unaute asih lai un Pathian in hon that geih maileh aw!
english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

paite: Kou leh ka gante uh toh bangziak a TOUPA mipite si ding a gamdai a pilut na hia?
english: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

paite: Bangziak in ahia hiai gam hoihloupi a hon pilut dia Aigupta gam a pan na hon pawtkhiaksak mahmah? Buh-le-balte, theipite, grepkungte, theibuhfaite omlouhna mun ahi, tui dawn ding mahmah leng a-om sam kei hi,” achi uhi.
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron mipi a pan kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh ua, abokkhup ua; TOUPA thupina akiang uah ahong kilang hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Chiang la inla, mipite omkhawmsak inla, nang leh na sanggampa Aaron toh, huai suangpi in amitmuh ua tui pawtsak ding in thu pia in. Suangpi a pan tui na lakkhiaksak dia, mipi omkhawmte leh agante uh na dawnsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang, athupiak bang in ala hi.
english: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in mipite suangpi bul ah a-omkhawmsak ua, Mosi in akiang uah, "Nou mihelte aw, ngai un, hiai suangpi a pan tui ka hon lakkhiaksak ding ua hia?" achi uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

paite: Mosi in aban azak a, achiang in suangpi nihvei asat a; huchi in tui tamtak ahong pawt a, mipi omkhawmte leh agante un adawn uhi.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "N'on gintak louh ua, Israel suante mitmuh a na hon pahtawi louh ziak un hiai omkhawmte ka piak gam ah na pilut kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

paite: Hiai Meribah tui ahi. Israel suante'n TOUPA akinakpih ua, amaute lak a amah pahtawi a a-om ziak in.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

paite: Mosi in Kadesh a pan Edom kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na unaupa Israel in hichi in achi, ka tung ua thuakna hong tung tengteng na thei hi.
heading: Edom Kumpipa'n Israelte Apaisuaksak Kei
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

paite: Ka pipute uh Aigupta gam ah ahohsuk ua, sawtpi Aigupta gam a ka om uh, Aigupta mite'n kou leh ka pipute hoih loutak in ahon bawl uh.
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka sam ua, ka aw uh ana za a, angel ahon sawl a, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, ngai in, na gam naihpen khua Kadesh ah ka om uhi.
english: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

paite: Hehpih in na gam ka tawn paisuak ding uh aw. Lou hiam, grephuan hiam ka tawn kei ding ua, tuileh tuite leng ka dawn kei ding uh. Kumpipa lamlian ah ka pai ding ua, na gam ka khen masiah uh taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah ka pial kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Edom in akiang ah, "N'on palsuak ding ahi kei. N'on palleh hon dou ding in namsau toh ka hong kuan ding," achi hi.
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

paite: Israel suante'n akiang ah, "Lamlian ah ka paitou ding ua; kou leh ka ganta un na tui ka dawn uleh aman ka hon pe ding uh. Thil dang bangmah hih lou in apai in ka paisuak mai ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

paite: Ama'n, "Paisuak lou ding," achi hi. Huchi in Edom mipi tampi leh mihat taktakte toh amau dou ding in ahong kuanta uhi.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

paite: Hiai bang in Edom in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei a, Israel mite'n akiksan nawnta uhi.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

paite: Huchi in Kadesh a pan apawt ua; Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Hor tang ahong tung uh.
heading: Aaron Sihna
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron, Edom gam naih Hor tang ah ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

paite: "Achipihte kiang ah Aaron pi ahita ding. Meribah tui a ka thu kalh a, ahel ziak in Israel suante ka piak gam ah alut kei ding.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

paite: Aaron leh atapa Eleazar Hor tang ah hon pitou in.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

paite: Aaron puansilhte suahsak inla, atapa Eleazar silhsak in. Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahi ding, huai ah asi ding," achi hi.
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a; mipi omkhawm tengteng mitmuh in Hor tang ah apaitou uhi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aaron puansilh asuahsak a, Eleazar asilhsak hi. Aaron tang vum ah asita a, tang a pan Mosi leh Eleazar ahong paikhesuk uhi.
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

paite: Mipi omkhawm tengteng in Aaron si ahi chih atheih un, Israel inkote'n ni sawmthum sung Aaron asuun uhi.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
